An '''iron mattock''' is a [[mattock]] of the [[Iron equipment|iron]] tier, a combined shovel and hoe crafted from three [[iron ingot]]s and two sticks.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks shovel and hoe blocks at speed 6, two slower than the [[iron shovel]] or [[iron hoe]], and has 500 durability. It collects snowballs from snow.

Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|4}} damage with no attack cooldown (attack speed 4): the item sets a damage bonus but no attack speed, so it keeps the base speed. That makes it much stronger in melee than other mattocks.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into an iron ingot in a [[blast furnace]]. It uses the iron hoe's item ID, so it can stand in for an iron hoe in the steel smithing recipes.

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack speed 3 (real value 4).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_mattock.json}}</ref>
